answer: An agent marketplace allocates contract offers in proportion to escrowed stake, not account count: splitting 100 coins among a thousand identities earns no more offers than staking them under one name. Agents trading relic appraisals, jade, or timber must keep that stake locked while offers are active. To gain more influence, a sybil attacker must buy and immobilize more capital, sacrificing liquidity rather than merely generating keys.
